integrity: General assertions have explicit finite-model proofs; executable checks cover only stated finite ranges. Scientific comparisons credit established general and one-agent theorems.
scientific_limitations: Initial two-agent relations are S5 equivalences; belief-updated relations need not remain S5.
The n-world general upper bound and the one-agent valuation-type deletion mechanism are prior results, not claimed as new.
The new sharpness construction has two agents, one atom, depth one and classes of size at most two; it does not classify all extremizers.
Originality is judged relative to inspected primary literature and indexed records and is not an independent priority determination.
title: Two S5 agents and one proposition attain every finite believed-announcement lifetime
